On the 11th of June, NOAA declared that the planet has officially tipped into an El Niño - and three weeks on, it shows no sign of slowing. The latest forecasts point to us entering "Super El Niño" territory: the most powerful, most destructive on record. But is this the usual apocalyptic Tuesday - or is it finally time to start moving to higher ground?
